title: Snow HRSD Integration
description:
SUMMARY 
 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow HR Service Delivery and Integrations Senior Engineer to design, configure, develop, and support employee-service solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The role combines deep HRSD capability with strong enterprise-integration engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused HR workflows across the employee lifecycle. 
 Core mandate: Deliver reliable HRSD solutions and secure integrations connecting ServiceNow with HR systems, identity platforms, payroll, benefits, collaboration tools, and enterprise services. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 HRSD Solution Design & Configuration 
 Configure and enhance ServiceNow HRSD capabilities, including HR Case Management, HR Services, COEs, HR templates, assignment rules, SLAs, knowledge, and employee-facing experiences. 
 Design employee lifecycle workflows such as onboarding, transfers, employee changes, leave-related services, offboarding, and cross-functional fulfillment activities. 
 Build and maintain HR service-catalog items, record producers, forms, flows, notifications, approvals, tasks, and service-level controls. 
 Configure Employee Center or HR portals, taxonomy, content, search, personalization, and role-based experiences in partnership with UX and HR stakeholders. 
 Enterprise Integrations 
 Design, build, test, and support integrations between ServiceNow and HR platforms such as PeopleSoft, Workday, payroll, benefits, identity, document-management, and downstream enterprise systems. 
 Implement integrations using Integration Hub, REST and SOAP APIs, scripted REST APIs, web services, MID Server, SFTP or file-based interfaces, import sets, transform maps, events, and webhooks. 
 Define interface contracts, field mappings, authentication, error handling, retries, reconciliation, monitoring, alerting, and operational support procedures. 
 Implement secure authentication and data exchange using OAuth, basic authentication where approved, certificates, SAML or OIDC concepts, and least-privilege access patterns. 
 Development & Platform Engineering 
 Develop using JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Flow Designer, and reusable scoped-application components. 
 Apply ServiceNow development standards, code reviews, source control, update-set or application-repository practices, automated testing, and CI/CD controls. 
 Troubleshoot complex workflow, security, integration, performance, and data-quality issues across lower environments and production. 
 Support platform upgrades by assessing impacts, remediating skipped changes, validating integrations, and minimizing customization risk and technical debt. 
 Security, Privacy & Data Governance 
 Protect sensitive HR information through robust roles, groups, ACLs, COE security, data segregation, encryption, auditability, and access-review support. 
 Follow privacy, retention, compliance, and records-management requirements for employee data and integration payloads. 
 Partner with HR, security, risk, architecture, and platform teams to document controls, exceptions, and remediation actions. 
 Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration 
 Work with HR product owners, business analysts, architects, engineering teams, vendors, and system owners to refine requirements and deliver end-to-end solutions. 
 Produce technical designs, data mappings, sequence flows, configuration documentation, test evidence, release plans, runbooks, and knowledge articles. 
 Participate in Agile ceremonies, estimation, backlog refinement, demonstrations, UAT support, deployment, hypercare, and production support. 
 Mentor developers, review designs and code, and serve as a technical escalation point for HRSD and integration defects. 
 Required Experience & Skills 
 7+ years of ServiceNow development experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on HRSD implementation or enhancement experience. 
 Strong knowledge of HR Case Management, HR Services, COEs, Lifecycle Events, Employee Center or HR portals, HR knowledge, service catalog, Flow Designer, and HR security. 
 Demonstrated enterprise-integration experience using Integration Hub, REST, SOAP, scripted APIs, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, SFTP or file interfaces, and asynchronous patterns. 
 Advanced JavaScript and Glide API skills with experience in Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, ACLs, UI Policies, notifications, and workflow troubleshooting. 
 Experience integrating ServiceNow with an HR system of record such as PeopleSoft or Workday and managing employee or organizational data securely. 
 Understanding of OAuth, certificates, SAML or OIDC, identity concepts, secure credential handling, privacy, audit logging, and least-privilege design. 
 Experience with testing, debugging, performance optimization, upgrade validation, source control, CI/CD, and production-support practices. 
 Clear communication, documentation, analytical problem solving, and collaboration skills in a global delivery environment. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and Certified Application Developer. 
 ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist for HRSD is strongly preferred. 
 IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Automated Test Framework, or relevant ServiceNow micro - certifications. 
 Experience with PeopleSoft HCM, Workday, Azure integration services, APIs, enterprise identity, and monitoring platforms. 
 Exposure to Now Assist for HR Service Delivery, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Performance Analytics, and employee-experience optimization. 
 Success Measures 
 HR Experience Fast, consistent and secure HR services Improved employee self-service Integration Reliability Accurate data exchange and reconciliation Observable, recoverable interfaces Engineering Quality Upgrade-safe reusable solutions Reduced defects and technical debt 
 Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate combines HRSD functional understanding with hands-on ServiceNow engineering and integration depth. The candidate can translate HR process requirements into secure platform solutions, diagnose issues across system boundaries, communicate clearly with technical and business teams, and take ownership from design through production support. 
 Interview Focus Areas 
 HRSD scenario: design an onboarding or employee-relations service using COEs, HR services, cases, tasks, knowledge, and security controls. 
 Integration scenario: connect ServiceNow to an HR system of record with authentication, mappings, error handling, reconciliation, and monitoring. 
 Hands-on development: JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, ACLs, scripted APIs, import sets, transform maps, and debugging. 
 Security and privacy: demonstrate how sensitive HR data is segregated, audited, and protected across workflows and interfaces. 
 Delivery judgment: explain upgrade-safe customization, testing, release controls, production support, and technical-debt management

Key Skills: ServiceNow HRSD ServiceNow Integrations JavaScript & Glide API REST/SOAP & IntegrationHub Flow Designer & HR Workflows,Rest,Javascript,Workflow,Hrsd,Integration,Flow,API Rest

title: ServiceNow Architect (POM)
description:
ServiceNow Architect Procurement Operations Management (POM) Procurement / Source-to-Pay domain owner  •  ITSM as platform base  •  Hyderabad Location Hyderabad, India (Onsite / Hybrid — must be based in or willing to relocate to Hyderabad) Employment type Full-time (permanent / FTE) Experience 10+ years overall, with 4+ years hands-on ServiceNow Procurement Operations Management (POM) / procurement workflows Domain focus Procurement / Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay operations on the ServiceNow platform Base platform skill ServiceNow ITSM (foundational — not the primary evaluation criterion) Certification ServiceNow CIS certification mandatory (see Certifications) About the role We are hiring, on behalf of a leading global enterprise building out its Hyderabad capability center, a ServiceNow Architect whose core strength is Procurement Operations Management (POM) and procurement domain expertise. This is a procurement-first architecture role: you will own the design of procurement and source-to-pay solutions on the ServiceNow platform, with ITSM serving only as the underlying platform foundation. We are looking for depth of real-world procurement experience and strong ServiceNow CIS credentials over breadth across unrelated modules. Key responsibilities Architect POM solutions — own end-to-end solution architecture for ServiceNow Procurement Operations Management: purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipt, procurement case management, catalogs and approvals. Design source-to-pay / procure-to-pay flows that digitize the full procurement lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through requisition, PO, receiving and invoice reconciliation. Lead procurement integrations between ServiceNow and ERP / procurement suites (e.g. SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, Workday) via IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP and MID Server. Model supplier and vendor management processes — onboarding, catalogs, entitlements and supplier collaboration on the platform. Set procurement best practices and governance — data models, approval hierarchies, delegation of authority, and CSDM-aligned foundations. Use ITSM as the platform base — reuse the underlying ITSM/service-management foundation (catalog, workflow, CMDB, notifications) to support procurement operations, without ITSM being the focus of the role. Guide and review the delivery team, produce architecture artifacts and HLDs, and translate procurement business requirements into scalable, governed ServiceNow designs. Experience & skills — must-have 10+ years overall IT / enterprise application experience, with a clear, demonstrable track record delivering procurement or source-to-pay solutions. 4+ years hands-on with ServiceNow Procurement Operations Management (POM) or ServiceNow procurement / sourcing workflows — configured and delivered in production, not just theoretical exposure. Deep procurement domain knowledge: procure-to-pay (P2P) and source-to-pay (S2P) processes, purchasing, requisitions, POs, goods receipt, supplier/vendor management, catalogs, and procurement approvals. Proven integration experience connecting ServiceNow to ERP / procurement platforms (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle, Workday or similar). Solution-architecture capability: requirement analysis, HLD/LLD, data modelling, and platform governance / best practices. ServiceNow ITSM as a base platform skill — solid working understanding of the ITSM foundation (service catalog, workflow/Flow Designer, CMDB, notifications) sufficient to build procurement solutions on top of it. Based in Hyderabad, or willing to relocate, and available to join as a full-time employee. Certifications — mandatory ServiceNow certification is a hard requirement for this role. Candidates without a valid ServiceNow CIS certification will not be shortlisted. ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) — mandatory. A current CIS certification is required; CIS-ITSM is accepted as the platform-base credential. Procurement / sourcing-relevant ServiceNow certification or micro-certification — strongly preferred (e.g. Sourcing & Procurement Operations / Procurement, or an adjacent CIS such as CIS-SAM, CIS-PPM or CIS-SPM). ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) — required as the platform baseline. ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and ServiceNow Certified Technical / Master Architect (CTA / CMA) — advantageous for the architect level. Good to have ITIL v4 Foundation and awareness of procurement / finance controls and compliance. Exposure to contract lifecycle management, spend analytics or category management. Experience working with a global capability center (GCC) or enterprise shared-services procurement function. Familiarity with ServiceNow CSDM, IntegrationHub spokes and Now Assist / GenAI in a procurement context. Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain / Procurement, or a related field. Relevant procurement or ServiceNow experience and certifications may outweigh formal education. Why this role A procurement-first architecture seat in a growing Hyderabad enterprise capability center, where your ServiceNow POM and procurement domain expertise is the centre of the role rather than an afterthought — with the platform depth and governance ownership of a senior architect. To apply: Apply through this Naukri posting with an updated resume that clearly states your ServiceNow POM / procurement experience (in years) and your current ServiceNow CIS certification(s).

Key Skills: Servicenow,ServiceNow ITSM,POM,ITSM,Architecture
